claims.assertion: She says Egyptian and Mesoamerican pyramids belonged to one planetary energy network; sacrifice did not define Egyptian culture but occurred regularly in Mesoamerica.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She identifies a Karnak structure as a portal marker. Seven doors and keys may indicate preset destinations or security levels; travel matches origin and destination frequencies.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Alternatives are offered for the seven-door function.

claims.assertion: She says aquifers improve soil conductivity in pyramid zero-point systems; inactive portals leave no energy, but ley nodes and piezoelectric stone retain detectable molecular-frequency traces.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
